children.name: Cephalotaxus alpina
children.description: The native range of this species is China (S. Gansu to N. & W. Yunnan). It is a shrub or tree and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Cephalotaxus fortunei
children.description: The native range of this species is C. & S. China to N. Myanmar. It is a tree and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Cephalotaxus griffithii
children.description: The native range of this species is Arunachal Pradesh to China (NW. Yunnan) and N. Myanmar. It is a tree and grows primarily in the subtropical biome.

children.name: Cephalotaxus hainanensis
children.description: The native range of this species is SE. Tibet to Hainan. It is a tree and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Cephalotaxus harringtonia
children.description: The native range of this species is China to Korea, C. & S. Japan, Taiwan. It is a shrub or tree and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Cephalotaxus mannii
children.description: The native range of this species is Assam to China (Yunnan, Guangdong, Guangxi) and Indo-China. It is a tree and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Cephalotaxus nana
children.description: The native range of this species is S. China, S. Korea, NW. & WC. Japan. It is a shrub and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Cephalotaxus oliveri
children.description: The native range of this species is S. China. It is a shrub or tree and grows primarily in the temperate biome.
